You can choose from ready-made presets like denim, cotton, and satin, and play with settings like fuzz, loose, and exposed threads, all fully customizable. markdown_content: ## Clo 2026.1 Feature Highlights: Realistic Ripped Garments (“Ripping and Tearing”) This section covers the new **ripping and tearing** workflow for creating realistic ripped garments, including how rip areas behave as independent objects and how fray customization works. **Ripping and tearing** introduces a seam-tearing process based on defining **rip areas** and then tearing the seam open. To use it: - **Designate part or all of a seam** as a **rip area**. - **Set rip resistance**. - **Tear the seam open**. Each **rip is its own object**, which means you can **create, edit, or delete** rip sections **without affecting the rest of the seam**. After ripping, **fray properties** allow customization of torn edges. Fray customization includes: - **Ready-made presets** such as **denim, cotton, and satin**. - Adjustable settings like **fuzz**, **loose**, and **exposed threads**. - Full customization of the fray look. If you want to keep a specific result: - **Deactivate the rip** to stop further tearing (locking the look). If you want to undo: - **Restore** the rip to its **original sewn state**. --- ## Knit Swatch Editor Upgrade: Real-Time Preview, Controls, and Editing Tools This section describes the major improvements to the **Knit Swatch Editor**, including a new interface layout, simulation tuning for tension and shrinkage, and enhanced selection/editing tools. The **Knit Swatch Editor** has been upgraded with: - A split interface: - **Real-time preview window (top)** - **Collapsible settings panel (bottom)** - A **flat view button** to lay swatches flat for easier editing. - **Instant preview updates** when changing **swatch size**. ### Expanded Simulation Controls Simulation controls were expanded to fine-tune: - **Horizontal and vertical tension** for **directional shrinkage** - **Flattening behavior** to emphasize or soften the **3D look** of **cables and tucks** ### New Select Edit Tool and Faster Editing A new **select edit tool** makes it easier to select: - **Stitches** - **Rows** - **Columns** - **Wales** Selected elements can be **copied, pasted, flipped, and moved**. Tool switching is faster: - Switch tools instantly with the **Tab key** - **Reapply styles** using the **eyedropper** ### Additional Stitch Types New stitch types expand knit design options, including: - **Tuck** - **Transfer** - **Cable** --- ## Pattern Creation and Knit Alignment: Stitch Options, Direction/Grainline, and Position Controls This section explains how knit patterns are created and edited, how knit direction links to grainline, and how new positioning controls align knit seams across pattern pieces. For creating an **all-new pattern**: - Open **stitch options** - Click the **seven-channel** option - Select the desired **stitch options** To quickly identify and adjust changes: - Use the **pattern selection tool** to set **different pattern patterns**. ### Knit Direction Linked to Grainline **Knit direction now links directly to the pattern’s grainline**, enabling precise alignment of knit seams between pattern pieces. New alignment controls: - **Position X** - **Position Y** These controls support accurate placement of knit seams across pattern pieces. --- ## Pattern Sovereignty and Pattern Information Window (Data, Notes, Stages, and Version History) This section covers new pattern data management features, including a **pattern information window**, cut quantity controls, notes, stage assignment, and **version history**. A new **pattern information window** helps view and edit **pattern data** more easily, including: - **Item number** - **Name** - **Fabric** - **Grainline** - Additional pattern-related fields Additional controls include: - Adjusting **cut quantity** - Adding notes to the **description column** - Adding a **stage** to the pattern so the team stays aligned ### Version History With **version history**, users can: - Save **checkpoints** - **Revert** to previous states **anytime with a click** --- ## Global Menu Search and Redesigned Right-Click Menu This section describes faster discovery of tools and functions using global search, plus a redesigned right-click menu with category tabs and real-time filtering. ### Global Menu Search Finding tools is streamlined with: - A new **magnifying glass** next to the **help menu** - Launching functions **instantly** via **global menu search** ### Redesigned Right-Click Menu The right-click menu has been redesigned with: - **Category tabs** - **Real-time search** Users can: - Type what they need to filter - Use **Tab** and **arrow keys** to jump between categories quickly - Avoid endless scrolling --- ## Workspace Customization: Group Tools, Favorites, and JSON Layout Export This section explains how to customize the UI workspace by grouping tools, stacking/hiding infrequently used tools, and saving layouts for reuse. Workspace customization features include: - Right-clicking the **toolbar** - Selecting **Group Tools** to: - **Stack** tools - **Hide** tools you rarely use - Dragging **favorite tools** to the top Layouts can be saved and reused: - Save the layout as a **JSON file** - Load the personalized setup on other workstations --- ## Graphic Locking and Transformation Safety This section covers a new **lock function for graphics** that prevents accidental changes to graphic size/placement. A new **lock function for graphics** allows adjusting **colorways and fabrics** without accidentally moving the graphic’s: - **Size** - **placement** How to use: - Activate it in the **Graphic Transformation** section, or - **Right-click the graphic directly** in the **2D window** --- ## Bag Capacity Measurement: Measurement Mesh, Volume in Liters, and Review Across Sizes This section describes how to measure bag capacity using a generated mesh, set target volume/tolerance, and compare results across graded sizes. ### Generate Measurement Mesh and Volume To set bag capacity: - Select your **pattern pieces** - Press **Enter** to generate a **measurement mesh** - The mesh displays **bag volume in liters** ### Validate Against Target Volume Users can: - Set a **target volume** - Set a **tolerance** - Confirm the design meets capacity requirements To adjust the mesh: - Use the **edit volume tool** to **move or resize** the mesh as needed. ### Compare Across Graded Sizes Use **2D Grading Review** to: - Compare **graphic placement and measurements** - View results **side-by-side** across all **graded sizes** in the **2D window** --- ## Information Display Options and Instant Export with Save Snapshot This section covers new display options for pattern-related info and the ability to export a reviewed layout instantly. New information display options can show: - **Pattern names** - **Annotations** - **Line length** - And more After finishing review, export is supported via: - **Save Snapshot** (export instantly) --- ## Seam Allowance Enhancements: Custom Defaults, New Corner Types, Point/Line Editing, and Rendering Across Seam Allowance This section covers upgrades to **seam allowance**, including custom default width, richer corner presets, point/line editing, locking, and improved rendering in print layout. ### Custom Default Width and Color Selection Seam allowance improvements include: - Setting a **custom default width** in **user settings** - Selecting a **seam allowance color** to make it easier to distinguish from the **pattern outline** ### Expanded Corner Type Presets Corner type presets were expanded to include: - **Slant** - **Round** - **Envelope** - **Pocket** These options help with more complex corners. ### Custom Seam Allowance: Point/Line Editing and Locking For deeper control: - Turn on **custom seam allowance** - Directly edit individual **points and lines** similar to editing the **pattern outline** - **Lock** the seam allowance when finished ### Print Layout Rendering In **print layout**, **fabrics and graphics** now render **fully across the seam allowance**. --- ## Shape Mode Tracing: Merge, Create, or Split Overlapping Patterns This section explains new tracing capabilities in **shape mode** for managing overlapping patterns directly in the 2D workspace. In **shape mode**, overlapping patterns can be handled by: - **Merging overlapping patterns** into one shape - **Creating one shape from another** - **Breaking overlapping regions into individual pieces** All actions can be performed **right in the 2D workspace**. --- ## Pattern Drafter Enhancements: Detail Blocks, New Necklines, Pockets, Yoked Trousers, and Avatar Matching (Including AI) This section covers updates to **Pattern Drafter**, including new detail blocks for variation, specific garment features, and automatic adjustments to match avatar size. Pattern Drafter now supports more design variation through: - **New detail blocks** for endless variations Examples of newly supported options include: - Neckline types such as **V-neck** and **square neck** - A **yoked trouser** option - New **pocket styles** - More additional pattern features ### Match to Avatar Size (Including AI Pattern Drafter) With **match to avatar size**, patterns adjust instantly to fit the avatar. This also works with **AI Pattern Drafter**. ---
